name: Add widget system
description: Добавить примерно 15 новых функций в приложение NotOC (React + Electron + Node.js + Socket.IO + PostgreSQL desktop app). Нужно определить, какие именно функции подходят ко текущей архитектуре, потому что оним не указаны конкретно.

goal.answer: Implement a widget system for the NotOC desktop including a settings catalog, desktop rendering with drag/resize/minimize, persistence, and ~15 widget examples covering core, productivity, data, and utility categories.

criteria.answer:
Settings panel has a 'Widgets' tab with a browsable catalog grouped by category
User can add a widget to the desktop from the catalog
Widgets render on the desktop and can be dragged to new positions
Widgets can be resized and minimized/restored
Widget state (position, size, minimized, config) persists to the user profile
Widgets can be removed from the desktop
Clock widget works (digital + analog display)
Calculator widget works (basic arithmetic)
Calendar widget shows current month with today highlighted
TODO widget supports add/complete/delete tasks
Sticky Notes widget allows creating/editing colored notes
Image widget displays an image file/URL
Weather widget shows current conditions via free API
System Monitor widget shows CPU/RAM usage
Password Generator widget creates random passwords
Color Picker widget picks colors from screen
Stopwatch/Timer widget works
Crypto/Stocks widget shows prices via free API
Quote of the Day widget shows a random quote
Network Speed/Ping widget tests connectivity
All widgets adapt to light/dark themes
npm run build passes with zero errors

constraints.answer: Only edit existing code/styles; no new runtime dependencies unless essential and approved, Preserve all existing desktop functionality (icons, windows, taskbar), Keep widget React components self-contained in apps/client/src/widgets/, Reuse existing theming CSS variables

phases.answer: Build widget engine, Core widgets, Productivity widgets, Data and utility widgets

assumptions.answer: A new widgets array field (or similar) will be added to the PublicUser profile and persisted via api.updateMe; Widget drag/resize can be implemented with existing React state + CSS without external libraries; Free public APIs (Open-Meteo/WTTR for weather, CoinGecko for crypto, quotable.io for quotes) are acceptable and may fail gracefully; System monitor widget can use basic Electron APIs or mock data in dev mode; Widgets on desktop sit above wallpaper but below desktop icons (or interleave cleanly); Adding a new settings tab 'widgets' requires updating SettingsTab, SETTINGS_TABS, and conditional JSX in Desktop.tsx; 15 widgets represent the full final set but may be delivered incrementally across phases

phases.name: Build widget engine
phases.goal: Create the widget system foundation: settings panel catalog, widget registry, desktop rendering layer, drag/resize/minimize, and persistence

steps.description: Add 'widgets' to SettingsTab, SETTINGS_TABS, and settings i18n keys; create Widgets settings section with catalog UI grouped by category
Create widget registry/types (WidgetType, WidgetState) and add widgets field to PublicUser / DB if needed; persist via api.updateMe
Implement desktop widget rendering layer: WidgetWrapper component with drag, resize handles, minimize button, close button; render via Desktop.tsx above wallpaper
Implement widget persistence: save/load position, size, minimized state, config to user profile; verify with mock add/remove

phases.name: Core widgets
phases.goal: Implement Clock, Calculator, Image Widget, and Calendar widgets using the new engine

steps.description: Build WidgetClock (digital + analog) and WidgetCalculator (basic arithmetic); register in catalog
Build WidgetImage (display image from URL/file picker) and WidgetCalendar (month grid with today)
Build and verify client passes with core widgets included

phases.name: Productivity widgets
phases.goal: Implement TODO, Sticky Notes, Timer, Stopwatch, and Password Generator widgets

steps.description: Build WidgetTodo (add/complete/delete), WidgetStickyNotes (colored notes), and WidgetTimer/Stopwatch

phases.name: Data and utility widgets
phases.goal: Implement Weather, System Monitor, Crypto/Stocks, Network Speed, Color Picker, and Quotes widgets

steps.description: Build WidgetWeather (free API fetch) and WidgetSystemMonitor (CPU/RAM via Electron or mock)
Build WidgetCrypto (CoinGecko fetch) and WidgetNetworkSpeed (ping + speed test)
Build WidgetColorPicker and WidgetQuote; verify full build
